overview.title: About the science unit
overview.description: Scientific activity connects education, clinical practice, and research in one ecosystem.
overview.p1: The science unit at Saribekyan International Medical University organizes and coordinates university research, scientific projects, and dissemination of results. Activity includes faculty, postgraduate researchers, and students.
overview.p2: Priority areas include biomedical and clinical research, public health, and education science aimed at improving medical education quality.
